name: @frontierjs/workbench
description: Workbench — the developer's own machine: Claude Code chats per pinned checkout, the registers read and ruled on, the loops as a town. An FJS application, not a library, and never published.
author: FrontierJS

scripts.dev: bun run api & bun run web & wait
scripts.stop: for p in $(pgrep -f 'bun.*api/inde[x].ts|vite.*web/config/vite.confi[g].js'); do [ "$(lsof -a -p $p -d cwd -Fn 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^n//p')" = "$(pwd -P)" ] && kill $p; done; true
scripts.db:check: cd db && bunx litestone migrate check && bunx litestone migrate lock --check
scripts.db:migrate: cd db && bunx litestone migrate create
scripts.db:reset: bun run stop; rm -rf db/workbench.db db/workbench.db-shm db/workbench.db-wal db/workbench-jobs.db db/workbench-jobs.db-shm db/workbench-jobs.db-wal
